description: python_snippet portable output: the value the script produced, with no enclosing envelope. A downstream template addressing steps.calc.output.total reads the script's own field.
notes: Asserts the output SHAPE only. Whether a script written the oracle's way runs at all is snippets.python_snippet.printed_json_is_taken_as_the_value — this vector passes on an implementation that removed an envelope and still ignores a printing script, which is why the two landed together.
